answer: Stop sybils with latency triangulation: each identity must prove one unique place. First, five beacons ping the node from different continents and time the replies. Second, the network triangulates its spot; two identities within 50 km are flagged as one machine. Third, re-pings freeze mismatches and burn a $200 deposit. Faking 10,000 identities means renting 10,000 spots at $80 a month — $800,000 monthly — plus $2,000,000 in deposits. Like a lotus in one pond, an identity blooms only where it stands; a spiral of fake addresses unwinds at the first ping, and no false haven survives it.
